Data:Dry.thing.generic.killes.json.label: Dry Something at the Killes
Data:Dry.thing.generic.killes.json.startdescription: I'm welcome to use the fire in the Killes' parlour.

Data:Dry.thing.generic.rectory.json.label: Dry Something at the Rectory
Data:Dry.thing.generic.rectory.json.startdescription: Reverend Timothy flutters fussily while Terrence the Housekeeper busies herself with practicalities.

Data:Dry.thing.generic.smithy.json.label: Dry Something at the Smithy
Data:Dry.thing.generic.smithy.json.startdescription: Denzil will allow me to use the forge fire - which does mean whatever I dry will smell afterwards of smoke.

Data:Dry.thing.generic.sweetbones.json.label: Dry Something at the Sweet Bones
Data:Dry.thing.generic.sweetbones.json.startdescription: I'm known at the Sweet Bones. They'll let me drip on the flagstone floor even if I don't buy beer.

Data:Ductile.json.label: Ductile
Data:Ductile.json.desc: [Take this to a Workbench to render it into Wire.]

Data:E.birdsong.json.label: Evolve via Birdsong
Data:E.birdsong.json.desc: I could use Birdsong with this to evolve my Soul. [Once you've committed a skill to the Birdsong Wisdom, you can use that skill with this to combine two identical Soul cards into a greater one. But you must use a skill you've attuned to that Wisdom, and the attunement will only work once.]

Data:Earthsign.json.Label: Earth-Sign
Data:Earthsign.json.Desc: 'In the Tracks of Beasts, in the Convolutions of his own Carapace, in Egg-vein and Shell-shadow, the Many-Eyed One found the Signs which can be History.' An Earth-Sign is an auspice traced on the cloaked shape of the earth, perceptible to the sensitive, interpreted only by the wise.

Data:Echidna.enroute.json.Label: Echidna is Coming
Data:Echidna.enroute.json.desc: War-wound and serpent-scar, by sky-street and desert-deep. Be ready.

Data:Echidna.enroute.persistent.json.Label: Echidna is Coming
Data:Echidna.enroute.persistent.json.desc: War-wound and serpent-scar, by sky-street and desert-deep. Be ready.

Data:Echidna.json.label: Mrs E
Data:Echidna.json.desc: The self-styled Mother of Monsters. A cheery, tubby woman in a green-grey garment like a baggy dirndl.

Data:Echidna.persistent.json.label: Mrs E
Data:Echidna.persistent.json.desc: The self-styled Mother of Monsters. A cheery, tubby woman in a green-grey garment like a baggy dirndl.
Data:Echidna.persistent.json.comments: If we lose the _visitor, we'll need inspired to be explicit

Data:Echo.json.label: Echo
Data:Echo.json.desc: [This memory has become part of something else.]

Data:Edge.json.label: Edge
Data:Edge.json.desc: All conquest occurs at the Edge. One who dwells there is blind, and cannot be wounded. Another is strong, and grows stronger. [Edge is the principle of battle and of struggle.]

Data:Edge.only.hint.json.label: Now What?
Data:Edge.only.hint.json.startdescription: There's potential here. [Start by adding a Soul card.]

Data:Effective.contamination.corruption..label: Effective Against Corruption
Data:Effective.contamination.corruption..desc: This skill can be used to remove Corruptions from books.

Data:Effective.contamination.curse.json.label: Effective Against Curses
Data:Effective.contamination.curse.json.desc: This skill can be used to remove Curses from books.

Data:Effective.contamination.infestation.label: Effective Against Infestations
Data:Effective.contamination.infestation.desc: This skill can be used to remove Infestations from books.

Data:Effective.contamination.theoplasma..label: Effective Against Theoplasmic Contamination
Data:Effective.contamination.theoplasma..desc: This skill can be used to remove Theoplasmic Contamination from books.

Data:Egg.boiled.json.Label: Boiled Egg
Data:Egg.boiled.json.Desc: Neatly packaged nutrition, pale as a December dawn.

Data:Egg.chicken.json.Label: Hen's Egg
Data:Egg.chicken.json.Desc: Delicious when cooked, alarming when dropped.

xexts.scrutiny: When it cracks, a craze of lines, the tiniest sound, and then a joyous freedom for potentially delicious goo.

Data:Egg.gull.json.Label: Gull's Egg
Data:Egg.gull.json.Desc: 'At Brancrug, even the Hours are kind, and the years are kinder.' This egg might stay viable quite a while yet.

xexts.scrutiny: When it cracks, a craze of lines, the tiniest sound, and then a joyous freedom for potentially delicious goo.

Data:Egg.json.label: Egg
Data:Egg.json.desc: 'When an egg is not dead, something may emerge. When an egg is dead, something may be placed within.' - Thirza Blake, seventh Librarian of Hush House

Data:Egg.relic.json.Label: Outsized Egg
Data:Egg.relic.json.Desc: An ostrich egg? A crocodile egg? Surely neither.

Data:Egg.scrambled.json.Label: Scrambled Egg
Data:Egg.scrambled.json.Desc: With bacon, scrambled eggs were the breakfast of Empire. In these less hegemonic times, Empire is optional; as is bacon.

xexts.scrutiny: Poor thing: coiled like a forbidden thought, never to see day.

Data:Ehsan.json.label: Mr Ehsan Fekri
Data:Ehsan.json.desc: Formerly; Ehsan was a healer; he was not human; he was Secretary Salvant of Hush House. But not all at the same time. Fussy, kind, famously foul to look upon.

xexts.scrutiny: A bitter but heady liquor. Drink it, and vision persists even after you close your eyes. [There are Prentice-level recipes to craft this with Winter - or, occasionally, Lantern.]
